summary_en: Share count upper limit raised from 3.0M to 6.0M shares (4.8% to 9.6% of S/O ex-treasury). Yen cap increased from ¥3.6B to ¥7.2B. Execution window extended from July–Nov 2026 to July 2026–Mar 2027. Method: open-market (ToSTNeT). As of 15 July 2026, 344.3k shares acquired for ¥357.5M under prior authorization.
title_en: Notice Regarding Expansion of Share Acquisition Frame
translation_en_brief: On 21 July 2026, KPP Group Holdings' board of directors resolved to expand the authorization for share acquisition under Article 165(3) of the Companies Act. The upper limit on shares to be acquired was doubled from 3.0 million to 6.0 million shares (representing 9.6% of shares outstanding excluding treasury, up from 4.8%). The total yen budget was similarly doubled from ¥3.6 billion to ¥7.2 billion. The execution window was extended from July–November 2026 to 1 July 2026 through 31 March 2027. The acquisition method remains open-market purchase via the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The board stated that the expansion reflects a comprehensive assessment of current business conditions, financial position, and cash generation capacity, undertaken to further strengthen efforts to enhance shareholder value. As of 15 July 2026, the company had acquired 344.3 thousand shares for ¥357.5 million under the prior authorization granted on 18 June 2026.
